scripts.build:free: vite build packages/host --mode free && node scripts/check-edition.mjs free --require-dist
scripts.build:tkf: vite build packages/host --mode ten-thousand-fleets && node scripts/check-edition.mjs ten-thousand-fleets --require-dist
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:dev && npm run build:free && playwright test -c packages/host/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run build:dev && npm run build:free && playwright test -c packages/host/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check:editions: node scripts/check-edition.mjs free && node scripts/check-edition.mjs ten-thousand-fleets && node scripts/check-edition.mjs dev
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:editions && npm run build:free && npm run build:tkf
